name: 仙剑奇侠传 (nitan170911)
group_note: NT/nitan lineage; branded 仙剑奇侠传. No admin account is pre-seeded (this lib's registration/save backend genuinely runs through MySQL, unconfigured in this environment; documented in its own README as a real, permanent exception rather than a bug) -- status corrected from a stale 'limited' by re-testing a fresh WASM registration instead: English id -> confirm -> Chinese surname + given name (common test names like 秦风 collided with pre-existing shipped player data, needed a genuinely unused combination) -> admin password + confirm -> login password + confirm -> character-type menu -> gender, entering the world cleanly with no errors; quit correctly triggers this lib's own new-account-deletion-within-30-minutes design (not a bug) and completes cleanly. The mysql_d.lpc db_connect()/db_exec() 'Undefined function' compile errors are expected and pre-existing (this driver build has no db package) and don't block play.
